name: TPS-CalcBench — Core Exact
protocol: TPS-CalcBench arXiv-v1 420-item high-confidence core, Track A, zero-shot standardized prompt, no tools/RAG/fine-tuning, exact <1% accuracy.

explanation.en: A response is exact when its extracted numerical result has under 1% relative error; missing outputs remain wrong over the full 420-item denominator.
explanation.zh: 提取数值的相对误差低于 1% 时计为 Exact；缺失输出按错误处理，分母始终是完整 420 题。

summary.en: TPS-CalcBench evaluates analytical calculations for hypersonic thermal-protection systems and high-temperature gas dynamics.
summary.zh: TPS-CalcBench 评估高超声速热防护系统和高温气体动力学解析工程计算能力。

task_format.en: The model solves 420 core engineering problems, shows calculation steps, and returns a final numerical answer with units.
task_format.zh: 模型解决 420 道核心工程计算题，展示计算步骤，并给出带单位的最终数值答案。
